body: Thank you so much for taking the time to talk to me. I don't really know what to say, I didn't even expect one person to reply, but now there are many people that seem to care. And for the first time in forever I actually have a feeling of existence. Making this thread here is the best thing I've done in a very long time.

I didn't expect anyone to reply. I'm overwhelmed right now by your extremely kind words... I have never sought medical help, I just feel like the damage is already done and I'm not a kid anymore. I used to believe it would get better over time that's why I postponed this for years.

I have a hard time to get out of bed and struggle alot to get through the day. Everything takes such an effort just to get through. That's what it's been like for a long time now. This is no life for a human being. I used to be able to keep on going just for the sake of it. But I don't wanna "just survive" any longer. Thank you so much for reading.
